description: On ordinary natural-number inputs, the chosen native PA checker program returns one exactly when the corpus’s actual PA proof-certificate checker accepts, and returns zero otherwise.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.native_checker_eval (x : Fin 2 → ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.certificateCheck
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier).eval
      x =
    if
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.paAxiomCertificate (x 0) (x 1) =
          true then
      1
    else 0
